The '''mother''' of [[Andra Cressen]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who had a daughter with [[Corlis Brado Cressen]], only to perish at some point during the [[Alderaan Civil War]] along with her sons, leaving only her husband and daughter alive.
